name: encode_kd_regulon
description: ENCODE shRNA/CRISPR knockdown RNA-seq functional regulon sets: KD vs matched-control log2FC per factor, split into up/down/regulated

inputs.name: encode_kd_manifest_tsv
inputs.description: Optional pre-built manifest TSV with columns: target, role (kd/ctrl), file_accession, href, experiment_accession. If not provided, the ENCODE portal API is queried live at https://www.encodeproject.org/search/ for shRNA/CRISPR RNA-seq experiments. Providing a manifest makes the run reproducible without network access.

inputs.name: ncbi_gene_info_gz
inputs.description: NCBI Homo_sapiens.gene_info.gz for ENSG-to-symbol mapping. If not provided, auto-downloaded from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/GENE_INFO/Mammalia/Homo_sapiens.gene_info.gz and cached under out_dir/references/.

parameters.name: assay
parameters.help: ENCODE assay title(s) to query. Use 'shRNA RNA-seq' (default) or 'CRISPR RNA-seq', or pipe-separated list 'shRNA RNA-seq|CRISPR RNA-seq'.

parameters.name: perturbation
parameters.help: Perturbation label for set descriptions and provenance (default: 'shRNA knockdown').

parameters.name: lib_prefix
parameters.help: Prefix for output set names. Defaults to 'ENCODE_<safe_assay>_regulon'.

parameters.name: lfc_threshold
parameters.help: log2 fold-change threshold for calling differential expression (default: 1.0; |log2FC| >= threshold). Corresponds to 2-fold change.

parameters.name: expr_threshold
parameters.help: Minimum expression threshold in TPM (or equivalent). Genes where max(KD, ctrl) < threshold are filtered before calling DE (default: 1.0).

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_regulated/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: All differentially expressed genes (up or down) on knockdown of this factor

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_up/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: Genes UP on knockdown (de-repressed; factor was a repressor or indirect activator)

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_down/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: Genes DOWN on knockdown (factor-dependent; factor was an activator or indirect repressor)
